visual.general_description: Scan of a twelve-lead ECG with black arrows on several complexes.
visual.detailed_description: Pink-gridded ECG paper with three rows of short lead segments arranged in four columns and three long continuous strips below. Printed lead labels include I, aVR, V1 and V4 in the first row; II, aVL, V2 and V5 in the second; III, aVF, V3 and V6 in the third, with lead labels V1, II and V5 at the left of the three lower long strips. Each row starts with a rectangular calibration pulse. Five solid black arrows point down at individual complexes: one above the V4 segment at the top edge, one above the V5 segment, one above the V3 segment, and one each above the second (II) and third (V5) lower long strips. No printed patient name, date, time, ID, heart-rate text or scale numbers are legible.

visual.general_description: Grayscale coronary angiographic-style image with a blue arrow at the proximal portion of the vessel tree.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale, grainy projection image taken from a screen. Dark contrast-filled branching vessels sweep from the upper left toward the lower right, with a long thin catheter-like line running vertically on the left side. A thick blue arrow with a black outline points up and to the right at a rounded dark focus along the proximal part of the large vessel near the upper left of the vessel tree. Faint rib and diaphragm shadows are visible behind the vessels. Printed text at the lower right reads FOV, RAO, CRA and L with partly legible numeric values; a small coiled or zigzag radiopaque mark appears near the top right. No patient name or ID is legible.
